name: Chicken Cordon Bleu with Prosciutto, Cheese, Lemon-Dijon Sauce & Roasted Asparagus (Prep-Ahead)

instructions.primary_message: This recipe utilizes 4 medium food storage containers.
Preheat oven to 425°F. Arrange rack in the upper third of the oven.

Wash, dry, and snap (or cut) off woody ends of the asparagus. Transfer spears to a large baking sheet pan, drizzle with oil, then season with salt and pepper. Toss to coat and spread out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 small bunch asparagus
4 tsp extra virgin olive oil
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, turning halfway through, until tender-crisp, 10-15 minutes. Remove from oven and set aside to cool, about 15 minutes.
Meanwhile, peel and mince garlic. Place in a small bowl.
Wash, dry, and juice lemon into the bowl with the garlic. Add broth, Dijon, and flour, then whisk until smooth. Set sauce aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 lemon
1 cup chicken or vegetable broth
4 tsp Dijon mustard
all-purpose flour

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large ovenproof skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets. Sprinkle both sides with flour, salt, and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless
all-purpose flour
½ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add chicken and cook until golden and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Transfer to a clean plate. (Reserve skillet with cooking juices for the next step.)

Return skillet (with cooking juices) to medium heat. Add sauce and cook, stirring constantly and scraping up any browned bits from the bottom of the skillet, until slightly thickened, about 1 minute. Remove from heat.
Return chicken to the skillet, then top with prosciutto and cheese slices.
When the asparagus is done, change oven to broil on high.
Place chicken in the oven and broil until cheese is melted and golden, 1-2 minutes. Remove from oven and set aside to cool, about 15 minutes.
When the asparagus and chicken are cool, divide between containers. Refrigerate until ready to eat. Warm in an oven or microwave and enjoy!
